description: This file defines an enumeration 'PdfUserAccessPermission' that specifies various permission flags for user access in PDF security, such as printing, modifying content, extracting content, annotations, form filling, assembling the document, and full quality printing. It is part of the PdfSharp library's security namespace.

classes.name: PdfUserAccessPermission
classes.description: An enum representing permission flags for PDF user access permissions, used to specify allowed operations when opening a PDF document.
